Cookies

When you visit our Website, we or one of our third party service providers may place a text file called a “cookie” in the browser directory of your computer’s hard drive. A cookie is a small piece of information that a website can store on your web browser and later retrieve information. The cookie cannot be read by any website other than the one that placed the cookie. Some browsers can be set to reject all cookies. If you choose to modify your browser in this manner, some pages of this Website may not function properly.

Upon your activation, these third party service providers may use cookies on our behalf to collect and store Internet log information, such as what time the visits occurred, whether the visitor has been to this site before, and what site referred the visitor to the web page. Geographic data may also determined by the IP Address of the visitor’s computer. If you activate such function, this information collected by the cookie may be transmitted to our third party service providers and may then be used to evaluate visitors’ behaviour and to generate statistical reports for the website activity on Sunwing Vacations Group’s Website and may be used for marketing purposes.

You can choose to disable cookies in your browser at any time by following the procedure described in the Tools or Preferences menu in your browser. If you choose to modify your browser in this manner, some pages of the Website may not function properly.

content.value: Start, run, and grow a profitable charging site with AI coworkers at your side. Launch quickly, keep sessions flowing, and let smart automation lift results. Stay operational even when the internet blips. You set the vision; the system handles the grind.

Win more jobs and finish them faster. Guided installs, remote checks, and clear handoffs turn complex work into smooth days. Talk directly to a charger, diagnose in minutes, and fix issues on site or from afar—fewer truck rolls, happier clients.

Introduce your chargers to ready buyers and keep every unit fresh. Present your lineup clearly, roll out updates with confidence, and see real-world performance across sites. Build trust with reliable hardware and constant improvement.

Build on an intelligent ecosystem that turns ideas into live features. Describe, test, and ship quickly to real sites. Create agents that watch, adjust, and delight customers. Publish once and reach owners, drivers, and partners at scale.

Imagine a platform born for the next era, not another dashboard. Bold, adaptable, and future-ready, it works beside you so your sites run smoothly while you focus on vision. Imagine tomorrow’s way of working, available today.

heading.en-CA: We Built It Differently for You. Ready for Tomorrow.

content.value: Starting with our
AI platform

AI-first CSMS

that leverages intelligent automation to manage and secure your entire infrastructure, activating AI precisely when and where it's needed. 

Leveraging our AI Agents, your operations will be significantly enhanced, allowing you to converse directly with your infrastructure (like chargers) while the agents
proactively manage maintenance, drive cost efficiencies, and apply smart power management
across the entire system.

Con nuestros Agentes de IA, sus operaciones se potencian: podrá conversar directamente con su infraestructura (por ejemplo, los cargadores), mientras los agentes gestionan proactivamente el mantenimiento, optimizan los costos y aplican una gestión inteligente de la energía en todo el sistema.
